::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jany 7th [1851-1881]  
**From:** 'Monthly Packet', 6, Paternoster Row, London E.C.  
**Manuscript:** MS National Library of Scotland 7179
:::

Dear [Madam](people/person_1817.qmd)

I see I did send your other poems to the printer, by confusion in the twilight.  But I like them so much as to be glad of it

yours truly
C M Yonge
